skill.name: skill-creator
skill.description: Guide for creating or improving AI skills with reusable workflows, scripts, references, assets, validation, and packaging for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
skill.summary: Create, validate, and package reusable AI skills with structured guidance and helper scripts.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: The static command, sensitive-file, and reconnaissance alerts are mostly false positives from markdown backticks, template text, validation errors, and zip packaging. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found. Two local filesystem risks remain in the helper scripts: unvalidated output names and unfiltered packaging.

remediation.issue: Skill names are not validated before directory creation.
remediation.suggestion: Reject names that fail the documented hyphen-case pattern, contain path separators, or resolve outside the requested output directory.

remediation.issue: The packager archives every file under the skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Add a default denylist for secrets, hidden VCS folders, caches, generated archives, and symlinks before writing the .skill file.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Skill Name Can Escape Target Directory
semantic_findings.description: scripts/init_skill.py joins the user supplied skill name to the target path before creating files. A name containing path separators could write outside the intended output folder.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script prints naming rules but does not enforce them before building skill_dir from argv. This is a direct local path traversal risk for untrusted input.

semantic_findings.title: Unfiltered Packaging May Include Unintended Files
semantic_findings.description: scripts/package_skill.py recursively writes every file under the selected skill directory into the .skill archive. A dirty folder could publish secrets, caches, or unrelated files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code includes all regular files returned by rglob without denylist, allowlist, or symlink checks. The archive is intended for distribution.

content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills can be inconsistent and slow. This skill guides structure, resources, validation, and packaging for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required skill folder structure and SKILL.md frontmatter.
Guides authors on when to add scripts, references, and assets.
Provides an initializer script for creating a new skill scaffold.
Provides a validator for basic frontmatter and naming checks.
Provides a packager that creates .skill archives after validation.
Includes reference guides for workflow and output pattern design.
limitations: It does not publish or install skills into a marketplace.
Generated templates contain placeholders that require manual completion.
Validation checks basic structure, not full security or writing quality.
Packaging includes files from the selected skill directory unless authors remove them.

use_cases.title: Create a New Agent Skill
use_cases.description: Scaffold a skill with required metadata, a clear instruction file, and optional resource folders.

use_cases.title: Improve Skill Instructions
use_cases.description: Refine SKILL.md content so triggers, workflow steps, and reusable resources are easier for agents to follow.

use_cases.title: Prepare Skills for Sharing
use_cases.description: Validate a skill folder and package it into a distributable archive for review or handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new skill for [task]. Ask only essential questions, then scaffold SKILL.md and any needed resources.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the skill at [path]. Tighten the description, remove excess context, and validate the folder after edits.

prompt_templates.title: Add Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: For this skill idea, identify scripts, references, and assets that would reduce repeated work. Add only resources with clear reuse value.

prompt_templates.title: Design and Package a Complex Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan, implement, validate, and package a skill for [domain]. Include workflow references, output patterns, and fixes for validation issues.

output_examples.input: Create a finance reporting skill with reusable references.
output: A concise skill structure with a clear trigger description.
A references plan for reporting schemas and metric definitions.

output_examples.input: Improve an existing PDF workflow skill.
output: A shorter main instruction file with clearer workflow steps.
Recommendations for moving detailed guidance into references.
Notes about scripts that need representative testing.

output_examples.input: Package a completed team skill for review.
output: Validation results for required frontmatter and naming rules.
A distributable skill archive when validation passes.
Warnings to remove private or temporary files before sharing.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md focused on essential procedures and move long details into references.
Add scripts only when they improve repeatability or reduce fragile manual work.
Run validation before packaging and review packaged contents before sharing.
anti_patterns: Do not create extra documentation files that duplicate SKILL.md.
Do not include assets, scripts, or references without clear reuse value.
Do not package folders that contain secrets, caches, or unrelated project files.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI skills with structured instructions, optional resources, validation, and packaging.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code skill authoring workflows.

faq.question: Can it generate a starter skill folder?
faq.answer: Yes. The included initializer creates a starter SKILL.md and example resource folders.

faq.question: Does the validator prove a skill is secure?
faq.answer: No. It checks basic structure and metadata. It does not replace security review.

faq.question: When should I add scripts to a skill?
faq.answer: Add scripts when repeated work needs deterministic execution or would be error-prone if rewritten each time.

faq.question: What should I check before packaging?
faq.answer: Review the folder for private files, temporary outputs, unused examples, and validation failures.
